// Reiner Aggregations-Hub, nur GET, keine Schreiblogik (siehe HUMAN_IN_THE_LOOP_ARCHITECTURE.md
// Abschnitt 2: "Aggregations-Hub offener Entscheidungen, rein lesend + Verlinkung"). Ein SELECT
// mit einer count/items-JSON-Spalte je Kategorie - gleicher Trick wie Paper-Trading-Review und
// News-Pruefen.
const sql = `SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.recommendations r
       LEFT JOIN trading.recommendation_decisions rd ON rd.recommendation_id = r.id AND rd.status = 'aktuell'
       WHERE r.status = 'offen' AND (rd.id IS NULL OR rd.entscheidung IN ('beobachten', 'spaeter'))) AS trade_entscheidungen_anzahl,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x)) FROM (
       SELECT r.id, r.ticker, r.richtung, r.opportunity_score
       FROM trading.recommendations r
       LEFT JOIN trading.recommendation_decisions rd ON rd.recommendation_id = r.id AND rd.status = 'aktuell'
       WHERE r.status = 'offen' AND (rd.id IS NULL OR rd.entscheidung IN ('beobachten', 'spaeter'))
       ORDER BY r.opportunity_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
     ) x) AS trade_entscheidungen,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.paper_trades pt
       LEFT JOIN trading.trade_reviews tr ON tr.trade_id = pt.trade_id
       WHERE pt.status = 'closed' AND tr.id IS NULL) AS trade_reviews_anzahl,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x)) FROM (
       SELECT pt.trade_id, pt.ticker, pt.net_pnl, pt.exit_time
       FROM trading.paper_trades pt
       LEFT JOIN trading.trade_reviews tr ON tr.trade_id = pt.trade_id
       WHERE pt.status = 'closed' AND tr.id IS NULL
       ORDER BY pt.exit_time DESC LIMIT 5
     ) x) AS trade_reviews,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_items ni
       JOIN trading.v_news_latest_assessment vla ON vla.news_id = ni.id
       LEFT JOIN trading.news_review_notes nrn ON nrn.news_id = ni.id
       WHERE vla.confirmation_status = 'unconfirmed' AND nrn.id IS NULL) AS news_reviews_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_false_negative_flags
       WHERE status IN ('possible_false_negative', 'filter_revision_required')) AS false_negatives_anzahl,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x)) FROM (
       SELECT nff.id AS flag_id, nff.news_id, ni.title, nff.status, nff.created_at
       FROM trading.news_false_negative_flags nff
       JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = nff.news_id
       WHERE nff.status IN ('possible_false_negative', 'filter_revision_required')
       ORDER BY nff.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
     ) x) AS false_negatives,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.learning_rule_proposals WHERE status = 'proposed') AS lernvorschlaege_anzahl,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x)) FROM (
       SELECT id, proposal_type, target_type, target_value, sample_size, confidence_level, created_at
       FROM trading.learning_rule_proposals
       WHERE status = 'proposed'
       ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
     ) x) AS lernvorschlaege;`;

return [{ json: { sql } }];
